feeds.title: The Bristol Magazine Online » Music
feeds.description: Here at Bristol, we aim to keep readers informed of all the good things going on in the city, previewing events across a diverse cultural mix, from comedy and children's events to art and drama, and reporting on the city's myriad of festivals. Articles on Orchestras, Albums, Artists and everything related to music are found here.

feeds.title: The Bristol Gig Guide
feeds.description: We aim to do as much as possible to foster the city that we love along with a diverse music scene and culture. The Guide blends The Bristol nomads' two great passions, photography and live music. We'll also provide full gig listings, venue information, gig previews, reviews and interviews.

feeds.title: Innate Blog
feeds.description: Set up by Owain Kin in 2014, Innate is an independently run website which covers Electronic Music, Art and Media - mostly in unequal doses. As an Independent Music Platform, we pride ourselves on featuring and promoting refreshing new music through honest and engaging features.

feeds.title: Bristol Music Lessons Blog
feeds.description: Bristol Music Lessons has a proud team of dedicated, professional teachers who are not only highly qualified but also experienced performers who possess the necessary personality & professionalism. We blog about different music clubs, instruments, guides, tips and more.

feeds.title: TrueStyleMusic
feeds.description: TrueStyleMusic was established in 2019 by Ted Stargatt. As a music blog, it aims to bring new and undiscovered artists into the spotlight, to get the recognition they deserve, with a specific focus on live music. Music doesn't discriminate, and all people and music are welcome here.

feeds.title: Bristol Beacon Blog
feeds.description: Bristol Beacon is a music charity, renowned venue and award-winning music education hub. With a city-wide programme of live music, creative learning opportunities and community engagement, we make space for music every day, with everyone. Read, Watch & Listen, a place where we share articles on everything related to music.

feeds.title: A&R FACTORY » BRISTOL
feeds.description: Since 2012, we have grown into one of the most respected artist and repertoire (A&R) blogs. We help discover new independent music from across the world. Our readership includes record labels, publishers, management companies, radio stations, P.R and sync companies who use our website as a resource to discover and sign acts.

feeds.title: The Fix Magazine » Music
feeds.description: The Fix Magazine are a Bristol-based online magazine running previews, reviews, interviews and worldviews about cultural happenings in the South West. Aside from covering all the best events in Bristol and beyond, we offer widely respected opinions on music, film, and theatre.

feeds.title: Wax Music
feeds.description: Wax Music is dedicated to exposing, promoting and featuring independent alternative artistry. From interviews, exclusive photoshoots and reviews to hosting gigs, Wax aims to create a unique platform for the ever-important musical communities across the UK.

feeds.title: The Birthplace of Country Music Blog
feeds.description: The Birthplace of Country Music is a nonprofit organization that seeks to perpetuate, promote, and celebrate Bristol's rich musical heritage; to educate and engage audiences worldwide, to create recognition, opportunities, and economic benefit for the local and regional communities. Stay updated with their latest posts on the blog.

feeds.title: Bristol24/7 » Music
feeds.description: Bristol24/7 is South West Bristol's biggest and best independent magazine and website. Find out what's happening across Bristol with news, features, what's on listings and everything in between. Latest news on Bristol's music events, concerts, artists and more is found here.
